profile.name: 牛津仪器 ITC503 温度控制器
profile.description: ITC503 是一款多传感器温度控制器，用于实验室中对一个或多个温度传感器进行读数，并对实验装置的温度进行监测与控制，常见于低温或环境温度稳定实验。
profile.description_en: The ITC503 is a multi-sensor temperature controller used in laboratories to read one or more temperature sensors and to monitor and control the temperature of experimental apparatus, commonly in cryogenic or temperature-stabilized setups.
